source.title: Neural-Collapse-guided Task-Free Continual Anomaly Detection
source.table_scope: MVTec AD image-level anomaly detection under OTFCL

metric_definitions.I-AUROC: Image-level Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve; used to assess discrimination between normal and anomalous images.
metric_definitions.I-AP: Image-level Average Precision; additionally reported because AUROC alone can be insufficient under severe class imbalance.

benchmark_and_protocol.training_protocol: Online Task-Free Continual Learning (OTFCL), single-pass; each sample accessed once
benchmark_and_protocol.stream_construction: samples shuffled within category, then category-contiguous segments concatenated to create abrupt distribution shifts; category labels unavailable to the learner during training
benchmark_and_protocol.evaluation_timing: unified evaluation after the data stream
benchmark_and_protocol.comparison_protocol: applicable methods use the same OTFCL stream and evaluation protocol

aggregation_localization.inference: Average is a category-level aggregate, but the paper text around Table I does not state the exact averaging implementation or whether unrounded category scores are used.
aggregation_localization.rounding_check: The arithmetic mean of the displayed one-decimal I-AUROC category values is 82.1333%, consistent with the reported 82.1% after rounding. The arithmetic mean of the displayed one-decimal I-AP category values is 91.7%, while Table I reports 91.8%, so the exact reported I-AP average cannot be reconstructed from the displayed rounded category values alone.
aggregation_localization.reproducibility_sensitive_assumption: Exact reproduction of the reported Average likely requires unrounded per-category scores and/or the authors' aggregation code. Treat the displayed 91.8% I-AP Average as a primary-source reported value, not as independently reconstructed from the rounded row.

bounded_action.tested_scope: Only NC-TFAD Table I and its immediately supporting evaluation-metric/protocol text were localized. No claims about Table II/III, ablations, code availability, seed variance, statistical significance, or independent replication were established in this slice.
bounded_action.duplicate_effect_resistance: This slice advances the prior quantitative-gap checkpoint by localizing one previously unaudited primary-source table; no prior semantic result was rewritten or broadened.
